title: ComplexConstraints and Beyond: Expert Rubrics for RLVR
title_zh: ComplexConstraints 及其扩展：用于 RLVR 的专家级评分 Rubric
abstract_en: As LLM capabilities advance rapidly, the evaluation methods used to assess them increasingly lag behind. Traditional benchmarks relied on programmatic verification of narrow, surface-level constraints, but real-world instruction following and agentic tasks demand assessment of nuanced, context-dependent behaviors that resist simple scripted checks. We present a systematic analysis of expert-curated rubric-based evaluation as an alternative paradigm, drawing on empirical evidence from two domains: complex instruction following and enterprise agentic tasks. We first articulate five design principles for constructing high-quality rubrics, including Maximum Viable Atomicity, intent-aware criterion design, and iterative LLM-judge calibration. To validate these principles, we introduce ComplexConstraints, a new expert-curated instruction-following dataset in which each prompt is paired with 10-40 atomic rubric criteria. We demonstrate that these expert rubrics are not only better evaluation instruments but also highly effective training signals: training on approximately 1,000 ComplexConstraints examples yields +15.5% improvement for a 4B-parameter model and +12.2% for a 235B-parameter model on instruction following, while single-epoch RL training on a rubric-graded enterprise environment produces gains that transfer to out-of-distribution benchmarks the model was never trained on (+4.5% BFCL, +7.4% Tau2-Bench, +6.8% Tool-Decathlon). Our findings establish that expert-authored rubrics improve both the measurement and the development of frontier LLM capabilities, serving as effective evaluation and RL training signals.
abstract_zh: 随着 LLM 能力快速提升，传统评测方法逐渐滞后：以程序化规则检查为主的 benchmark 往往只能验证狭窄、表层的约束，而真实世界的指令遵循与 agentic 任务需要评估更细腻、依赖上下文且难以脚本化判断的行为。本文系统分析了专家构建的 rubric-based evaluation 作为替代范式的价值，并基于复杂指令遵循与企业级 agentic 任务两个领域的实证结果展开验证。作者提出了构建高质量 rubric 的五项设计原则，包括 Maximum Viable Atomicity、意图感知的 criterion 设计，以及迭代式 LLM-judge 校准。为验证这些原则，论文引入 ComplexConstraints：一个新的专家构建指令遵循数据集，每个 prompt 配有 10–40 条原子化评分标准。实验表明，专家 rubric 不仅是更好的评测工具，也能作为高效训练信号：仅用约 1,000 条 ComplexConstraints 样本训练，可使 4B 模型指令遵循能力提升 15.5%，235B 模型提升 12.2%；在 rubric 评分的企业环境中进行单轮 RL 训练，还能迁移到未训练过的 OOD benchmark，上涨包括 BFCL +4.5%、Tau2-Bench +7.4%、Tool-Decathlon +6.8%。研究表明，专家撰写的 rubric 能同时改进前沿 LLM 能力的测量与训练，并可作为有效的 evaluation 与 RL training signal。
key_points_zh: 论文主张用专家构建的 rubric-based evaluation 替代传统脚本化检查，以评估复杂指令遵循和 agentic 任务中更细粒度、上下文相关的行为。
提出五项 rubric 设计原则，包括 Maximum Viable Atomicity、意图感知 criterion 设计、迭代式 LLM-judge calibration 等，用于提升评分标准的可靠性和可操作性。
发布 ComplexConstraints 数据集：每个指令 prompt 配备 10–40 条专家撰写的原子化 rubric criteria，面向复杂约束下的指令遵循评测与训练。
实验证明 rubric 可作为强训练信号：约 1,000 条 ComplexConstraints 样本即可让 4B 模型提升 15.5%、235B 模型提升 12.2%。
在企业级 agentic 环境中进行 rubric-graded RL 后，模型在未见过的 OOD benchmark 上也有迁移收益，包括 BFCL、Tau2-Bench 和 Tool-Decathlon。

llm_assessment.comment: Expert rubrics for RLVR are relevant to agent evaluation and training gates, especially with enterprise agentic tasks, but they do not define a full harness runtime.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 面向 RLVR 的专家 rubric 对智能体评估和训练门控较有价值，尤其涉及企业智能体任务，但并未提出完整运行时框架。
